title: Hacia los años noventa
goal: Read a closing synthesis of this unit's three storylines -- the global system's 1989-1991 collapse, Washington's reordered priorities, and Cuba's crisis -- and the transformed international framework the region entered the 1990s within.

items: State how quickly the Cold War system dissolved.
Summarize the shift in US policy priorities.
Explain what Cuba's crisis represented for the region.
Describe how regional foreign policy changed by 1992.
Use en última instancia to draw a final conclusion.
I can state how quickly the Cold War system dissolved.
I can summarize the shift in US policy priorities.
I can explain what Cuba's crisis represented for the region.

I can use en última instancia to draw a final conclusion.
